mission_02: Text data augmentation creates variations of existing text samples to increase training data diversity. Common techniques include synonym replacement (swapping words with their synonyms), random insertion (adding synonyms at random positions), random swap (exchanging word positions), and random deletion (removing words). These techniques preserve the semantic meaning while introducing lexical variation, helping models generalize better. In this mission, you will implement basic text augmentation techniques from scratch using Python's random module and a simple synonym dictionary, demonstrating the core concepts of NLP data augmentation.
